newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Refugees, militias flee Zaire camps after fighting.
newsitem.headline: Refugees, militias flee Zaire camps after fighting.

text.p: Tens of thousands of Rwandan refugees have left the sprawling eastern Zaire Mugunga refugee camp and on Friday moved through the town of Goma to the Rwandan border after fighting around the camp.

Reuters correspondent Christian Jennings said thousands of refugees have already passed through the town and for up to one km (half-a-mile) from Goma the road is blocked as far as the eye can see with returning refugees.
Refugees told Jennings they and Rwandan militiamen in the camps were fleeing after the fighting.
They said the Interahamwe militiamen had moved into the bush with their weapons while many of the refugees decided to move for Rwanda.
Fighting raged around Goma for six hours on Thursday as Tutsi rebels took on the exiled Rwandan forces.
